interview_entries.question: What fat ratio do you use for burgers?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I use 80/20 beef, so at least 20% fat. Anything leaner comes out dry.
interview_entries.source: SAMPLE - replace with Interview S1 note/timestamp

interview_entries.question: How thick or heavy is a patty?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I portion 90 g balls and smash them thin on the flat top.

interview_entries.question: How and when do you season the burger?
interview_entries.chef_answer: Salt and pepper go on right after the smash, on the side facing up. Never mix salt into the meat.

interview_entries.question: Pan or grill, and how hot?
interview_entries.chef_answer: Flat top or cast iron at very high heat, around 230 C. It has to be smoking hot for the crust.

interview_entries.question: Do you press burgers while cooking?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I smash once, in the first 10 seconds. After that I never press, because pressing pushes the juices out.

interview_entries.question: How do you know a burger is done without cutting it?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I flip when the edges are dark brown and lacy and juices pool on top, about 90 seconds. Second side is under a minute.

interview_entries.question: How do you toast the bun and when do you add cheese?
interview_entries.chef_answer: Buttered bun goes face down on the flat top for 30 seconds. Cheese goes on straight after the flip so it melts under the steam.

interview_entries.question: What is the biggest mistake home cooks make with burgers?
interview_entries.chef_answer: Pressing the patty, and using lean beef. Both dry it out.

interview_entries.question: Do you use frozen beef?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I prefer fresh. If it has to be frozen, I thaw it in the fridge overnight, never on the counter.

interview_entries.question: How much water and salt for pasta?
interview_entries.chef_answer: About 1 litre of water per 100 g of pasta, with 10 g salt per litre, added once the water boils.

interview_entries.question: How do you know pasta is al dente?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I pull it 2 minutes before the packet time and bite one piece. There should be a thin white dot in the centre.

interview_entries.question: When do you use pasta water?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I keep a cup of it. It goes into the pan with the sauce, a splash at a time, to make it silky and cling.

interview_entries.question: What is the sauce to pasta ratio and assembly order?
interview_entries.chef_answer: Pasta goes into the sauce, not the other way round. Toss over heat for a minute, sauce should coat, not pool.

interview_entries.question: What do you serve for gluten-free requests?
interview_entries.chef_answer: I use corn-and-rice gluten-free pasta and cook it 1 minute less. For anything medical like celiac, ask me first.
